papers.title: The Rise of Economic Coercion: Instruments, Illegality, and UN Charter Remedies
papers.abstract: The growing recourse to economic coercion in contemporary international relations has raised fundamental questions about its implications for international peace and the legal limits imposed by the UN Charter framework. Based on the relevant international relations literature and doctrinal legal analysis, this article examines the contemporary rise of economic coercion, the instruments through which it operates, and the extent to which such practices may be considered unlawful under the UN Charter, as well as the legal and institutional mechanisms available within the UN system to deter and respond to them. The findings suggest that the contemporary rise of economic coercion is driven by strategic competition within conditions of deep economic interdependence, where states increasingly weaponize trade, finance, technology, and investment networks to gain geopolitical leverage. While not universally recognized as “force” under Article 2(4), many forms of economic coercion violate the principle of non-intervention under Article 2(7) and may constitute internationally wrongful acts. Meanwhile, the UN system—through countermeasures, self-defense doctrines, Security Council action, and regional arrangements—provides existing but underutilized legal and institutional tools to regulate and deter such practices.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在当代国际关系中，经济胁迫手段的日益频繁使用引发了关于其对国际和平的影响以及《联合国宪章》框架所规定的法律限制的基本问题。本文基于相关的国际关系文献和法律理论分析，探讨了经济胁迫的兴起、其实施手段，以及这些行为在多大程度上可能被视为违反《联合国宪章》的规定。同时，文章还分析了联合国体系内可用于遏制和应对经济胁迫的法律和制度机制。研究结果表明，经济胁迫的加剧源于各国在经济高度相互依存背景下的战略竞争，各国越来越多地利用贸易、金融、技术和投资网络作为工具来获取地缘政治优势。尽管许多形式的经济胁迫并未被普遍视为《联合国宪章》第2(4)条所定义的“武力”，但它们确实违反了第2(7)条规定的不干涉原则，可能构成国际不法行为。联合国体系通过反制措施、自卫原则、安理会行动以及区域安排等手段，提供了现有的但尚未得到充分运用的法律和制度工具来规范和遏制此类行为。。

papers.title: Triple/Double-Debiased Lasso
papers.abstract: In this paper, we propose a triple (or double-debiased) Lasso estimator for inference on a low-dimensional parameter in high-dimensional linear regression models. The estimator is based on a moment function that satisfies not only first- but also second-order Neyman orthogonality conditions, thereby eliminating both the leading bias and the second-order bias induced by regularization. We derive an asymptotic linear representation for the proposed estimator and show that its remainder terms are never larger and are often smaller in order than those in the corresponding asymptotic linear representation for the standard double Lasso estimator. Because of this improvement, the triple Lasso estimator often yields more accurate finite-sample inference and confidence intervals with better coverage. Monte Carlo simulations confirm these gains. In addition, we provide a general recursive formula for constructing higher-order Neyman orthogonal moment functions in Z-estimation problems, which underlies the proposed estimator as a special case.
papers.summary_zh: 【行为金融】在本文中，我们提出了一种用于高维线性回归模型中低维参数推断的三重（或双重去偏）Lasso估计量。该估计量基于一种满足一阶和二阶Neyman正交条件的矩函数，从而消除了由正则化引入的主要偏差和二阶偏差。我们推导出了所提出估计量的渐近线性表示，并证明了其余项的阶数永远不会超过标准双重Lasso估计量的相应渐近线性表示中的余项，且通常更小。由于这一改进，三重Lasso估计量往往能够提供更准确的有限样本推断结果和具有更好覆盖率的置信区间。蒙特卡洛模拟结果证实了这些优势。此外，我们还提供了一个通用递归公式，用于构造Z-估计问题中的高阶Neyman正交矩函数，而所提出的估计量正是该公式的一个特例。。研究方法：回归分析、蒙特卡洛模拟、数值模拟。

papers.title: Market Power and Platform Design in Decentralized Electricity Trading
papers.abstract: This paper studies how platform design shapes strategic behavior in decentralized electricity trading. We develop a finite-horizon dynamic game in which photovoltaic- and battery-equipped players ("prosumers") trade on a platform that maps aggregate imports and exports into internal buy and sell prices. We establish existence of a perfect conditional epsilon-equilibrium and characterize a Cournot-like market-power mechanism in an observable-types benchmark of the game: because the producer price is decreasing in aggregate exports, strategic prosumers withhold supply and underutilize storage relative to the price-taking benchmark. To quantify these effects, we use a multi-agent computational framework that exploits the differentiable structure of the platform's clearing rule to compare planner, price-taking, and strategic outcomes under alternative pricing mechanisms. In our baseline calibration, strategic play raises grid settlement cost by about 6 percent relative to price-taking. The magnitude of the distortion depends strongly on platform design: some designs can largely eliminate strategic incentives, while increased competition in storage ownership sharply reduces withholding, with most of the distortion disappearing once storage is split across more than three owners. We also find that information disclosure can improve competitive coordination but also increase the market power effects. Despite these distortions, the platform remains highly valuable overall, reducing a passive consumer's annual electricity bill by roughly 40 percent relative to exclusive grid settlement, with strategic behavior clawing back only about 8 percent of that saving. The results show that pricing rules, information disclosure, and ownership structure determine how much of the gains from decentralized electricity trading are realized.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文研究了平台设计如何影响分散式电力交易中的战略行为。我们构建了一个有限视界的动态博弈模型，在该模型中，配备光伏发电和蓄电池的参与者（“产消者”）在平台上进行交易，该平台将总的电力进出口量转化为内部买卖价格。我们证明了完美条件下的ε-均衡的存在性，并在该博弈的可观测类型基准框架下分析了类似古诺竞争的市场力量机制：由于生产者价格随总出口量的增加而降低，具有战略行为的产消者会减少供应并降低储能设施的利用率（相对于完全接受价格的竞争情形）。为了量化这些影响，我们采用了一个多智能体计算框架，利用平台清算规则的可微分特性来比较不同定价机制下的各种竞争结果。在基准情景下，与完全接受价格的情况相比，具有战略行为的参与者会导致电网结算成本增加约6%。这种扭曲的程度受到平台设计的显著影响：某些平台设计能够有效消除产消者的战略动机；而储能设施所有权的竞争加剧会显著减少供应行为的减少，当储能设施由多个所有者共同持有时，大部分扭曲效应会消失。我们还发现，信息披露虽然有助于提升竞争协调性，但也会增强市场力量效应。尽管存在这些扭曲，该平台总体上仍具有很高的价值——与完全依赖电网结算的方式相比，它能使消费者的...。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Deep Learning Projects Jurisdiction of New and Proposed Clean Water Act Regulation -- by Simon Greenhill, Brant J. Walker, Joseph S. Shapiro
papers.abstract: Projecting the effects of proposed policy reforms is challenging because no outcome data exist for regulations that governments have not yet implemented. We propose an ex ante deep learning framework that can project effects of proposed reforms by mapping outcomes observed under past regulations onto the legal criteria of proposed future policies (i.e., by “relabeling”). We apply this framework to study changes in jurisdiction of the US Clean Water Act (CWA). We compare our ex ante deep learning projection of jurisdiction under the Supreme Court’s Sackett decision against widely used projections from domain experts. Ex ante machine learning generates exceptional performance improvements over the leading domain expert model that the US Environmental Protection Agency currently uses, with 65 times more accurate identification of jurisdictional sites. We also develop an ex post deep learning model trained with data after policy implementation. Ex post deep learning performs best. Sackett deregulates one-third of all previously regulated US waters, particularly floodplains and pristine fish habitats, totaling 700,000 deregulated stream miles and 17 million deregulated wetland acres. Deep learning can effectively project consequences of far-reaching regulatory reforms before they are implemented, when projections are both most uncertain and most useful.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：如何预测尚未实施的政策改革的影响，特别是针对美国《清洁水法》（CWA）管辖权变更的评估？

🔬 研究方法：提出了一种事前深度学习框架，通过将过去监管下的结果映射到未来政策标准（即“重新标记”）来预测改革影响；同时开发了事后深度学习模型进行验证。

📊 核心发现：事前深度学习预测比美国环保署（EPA）专家模型准确 65 倍，且事后深度学习模型表现最佳；Sackett 决定取消了约三分之一的受监管水域，涉及 70 万英里河流和 1700 万英亩湿地。

💡 应用价值：深度学习能够有效预测广泛监管改革

papers.title: We've Got You Covered: Firms' Political Stances on Abortion and Labor Market Sorting -- by Pawel Adrjan, Svenja Gudell, Emily E. Nix, Allison Shrivastava, Jason Sockin, Evan P. Starr
papers.abstract: Amidst rising political polarization, firms engage more frequently with political issues through public statements and policies. This paper examines how firms' stances on polarizing issues impact worker sorting, leveraging announcements from hundreds of employers following the Supreme Court's ruling in Dobbs v. Jackson, overturning federal abortion rights. We introduce a methodology to uncover labor market competitors for each announcing firm based on job seekers' revealed preferences. While announcing firms received more applications from job seekers, particularly in Democratic-leaning states and female-dominated jobs where abortion was outlawed, current employees began searching for jobs elsewhere as employee satisfaction declined, particularly among male-dominated jobs. Smaller companies with less-established reputations experienced the largest effects. When deciding whether to take a sociopolitical stance, firms face a complicated trade-off: attracting culturally-aligned workers at the expense of alienating current ones.
papers.summary_zh: 【公司金融】在政治两极分化日益严重的背景下，企业更频繁地通过公开声明和政策参与政治议题的讨论。本文研究了企业在具有争议性议题上的立场如何影响劳动力的分配情况，研究数据来源于最高法院在“多布斯诉杰克逊案”（Dobbs v. Jackson）中推翻联邦堕胎权利裁决后数百家企业的公开声明。我们采用了一种方法论，根据求职者的偏好来识别每家发布声明企业的劳动力市场竞争对手。虽然发布声明的企业收到了更多求职者的申请，尤其是在民主党倾向较强的地区以及堕胎被禁止的女性主导行业中，但现有员工的满意度却有所下降，尤其是在男性主导的行业中。声誉较低的小型企业受到的影响最为显著。企业在决定是否采取社会政治立场时面临着一个复杂的权衡：一方面可以吸引与自身文化理念相符的求职者，另一方面可能会疏远现有的员工。。

papers.title: If Not Now, Then When? Model Risk in the Optimal Exercise of American Options
papers.abstract: Model risk arises from the misspecification of probabilistic models used for pricing and hedging derivatives. While model risk for European-style claims has been widely studied, much less attention has been given to American-style derivatives and the associated optimal stopping problems. This paper analyzes model risk in the optimal exercise of an American put option using the benchmark methodology of Hull and Suo [2002]. The true data-generating process is assumed to follow a Heston stochastic volatility model. We compare the optimal exercise strategy of an investor who correctly uses the Heston model with those of investors who instead use misspecified Black--Scholes or Dupire local volatility models. Optimal exercise boundaries are computed numerically via finite difference methods. Stochastic volatility dynamics and return--volatility correlation are found to have a substantial impact on optimal exercise behavior across models, creating a source of model risk. As this behavior is not transmitted to exercise strategies determined by misspecified models, even if such models are fully calibrated to European option prices, calibration fails to mitigate model risk in this context. This issue persists under frequent recalibration of a misspecified model.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】模型风险源于用于衍生品定价和对冲的概率模型的错误设定。尽管欧式衍生品的模型风险已得到广泛研究，但美式衍生品及其相关的最优停止问题却鲜有关注。本文采用Hull和Suo（2002年）提出的基准方法，分析了美式看跌期权最优执行过程中的模型风险。假设真实数据生成过程遵循Heston随机波动率模型。我们比较了正确使用Heston模型的投资者与使用错误设定的Black-Scholes模型或Dupire局部波动率模型的投资者的最优执行策略。最优执行边界通过有限差分方法进行数值计算。研究发现，随机波动率动态和收益-波动率相关性对不同模型下的最优执行行为有显著影响，从而构成了模型风险的来源。由于这种影响不会传递到由错误设定模型确定的执行策略上，即使这些模型能够完全校准到欧式期权价格，校准也无法在这种情况下有效缓解模型风险。即使在频繁重新校准错误设定模型的情况下，这一问题依然存在。。研究方法：随机过程。

papers.title: Large Language Models and Stock Investing: Is the Human Factor Required?
papers.abstract: This paper investigates whether large language models (LLMs) can generate reliable stock market predictions. We evaluate four state-of-the-art models - ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, and Perplexity - across three prompting strategies: a naive query, a structured approach, and chain-of-thought reasoning. Our results show that LLM-generated recommendations are hindered by recurring reasoning failures, including financial misconceptions, carryover errors, and reliance on outdated or hallucinated information. When appropriately guided and supervised, LLMs demonstrate the capacity to outperform the market, but realizing LLMs' full potential requires substantial human oversight. We also find that grounding stock recommendations in official regulatory filings increases their forecasting accuracy. Overall, our findings underscore the need for robust safeguards and validation when deploying LLMs in financial markets.
papers.summary_zh: 【资产定价】本文探讨了大型语言模型（LLMs）是否能够生成可靠的股票市场预测结果。我们评估了四种最先进的模型——ChatGPT、Gemini、DeepSeek和Perplexity——并采用了三种不同的提示策略：简单查询、结构化方法以及思维链推理。研究结果表明，LLM生成的预测结果受到反复出现的推理错误的影响，这些错误包括金融认知偏差、信息延续性错误以及对过时或虚假信息的依赖。在适当的引导和监督下，LLMs确实能够超越市场表现，但要充分发挥其潜力仍需要大量的人工干预。此外，我们将股票推荐与官方监管文件相结合，发现这能够显著提高预测的准确性。总体而言，我们的研究结果强调了在金融市场中应用LLMs时需要采取强有力的保障措施和验证机制。。

papers.title: Optimal Hedge Ratio for Delta-Neutral Liquidity Provision under Liquidation Constraints
papers.abstract: We study the problem of optimally hedging the price exposure of liquidity positions in constant-product automated market makers (AMMs) when the hedge is funded by collateralized borrowing. A liquidity provider (LP) who borrows tokens to construct a delta-neutral position faces a trade-off: higher hedge ratios reduce price exposure but increase liquidation risk through tighter collateral utilization. We model token prices as correlated geometric Brownian motions and derive the hedge ratio h that maximizes risk-adjusted return subject to a liquidation-probability constraint expressed via a first-passage-time bound. The unconstrained optimum h* admits a closed-form expression, but at h* the liquidation probability is prohibitively high. The practical optimum h** = min(h*, h_bar(alpha)) is determined by the binding liquidation constraint h_bar(alpha), which we evaluate analytically via the first-passage-time formula and confirm with Monte Carlo simulation. Simulations calibrated to on-chain data validate the analytical results, demonstrate robustness across realistic parameter ranges, and show that the optimal hedge ratio lies between 50% and 70% for typical DeFi lending conditions. Practical guidelines for rebalancing frequency and position sizing are also provided.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了在恒定产品自动做市商（AMMs）中，如何通过抵押借款来最优地对流动性头寸的价格风险进行对冲的问题。流动性提供者（LP）通过借款来构建一个Delta中性头寸，从而面临一个权衡：较高的对冲比率可以降低价格风险，但会因更严格的抵押品使用而增加清算风险。我们将代币价格建模为相关的几何布朗运动，并推导出在清算概率约束（通过首次通过时间界限来表达）下最大化风险调整后回报的对冲比率h。无约束情况下的最优对冲比率h*存在封闭形式的表达式，但在该比率下清算概率过高，难以实际应用。实际最优对冲比率h** = min(h*, h_bar(alpha))由清算约束h_bar(alpha)决定，我们通过首次通过时间公式对其进行了分析验证，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟进行了确认。根据链上数据校准的模拟结果验证了分析结论，证明了该模型在现实参数范围内的稳健性，并表明在典型的去中心化金融（DeFi）借贷条件下，最优对冲比率介于50%至70%之间。此外，我们还提供了关于再平衡频率和头寸规模设定的实际指导原则。。研究方法：蒙特卡洛模拟、数值模拟。

papers.title: Dynamic Pareto Optima in Multi-Period Pure-Exchange Economies
papers.abstract: We study a problem of optimal allocation in a discrete-time multi-period pure-exchange economy, where agents have preferences over stochastic endowment processes that are represented by strongly time-consistent dynamic risk measures. We introduce the notion of dynamic Pareto-optimal allocation processes and show that such processes can be constructed recursively starting with the allocation at the terminal time. We further derive a comonotone improvement theorem for allocation processes, and we provide a recursive approach to constructing comonotone dynamic Pareto optima when the agents' preferences are coherent and satisfy a property that we call equidistribution-preserving. In the special case where each agent's dynamic risk measure is of the distortion type, we provide a closed-form characterization of comonotone dynamic Pareto optima. We illustrate our results in a two-period setting.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了一个离散时间多期纯交换经济中的最优分配问题，在该经济中，代理人对随机禀赋过程具有偏好，这些随机禀赋过程由强时间一致性的动态风险度量来表示。我们引入了动态帕累托最优分配过程的概念，并证明了这类过程可以从终端时间的分配情况开始递归构建。进一步地，我们推导出了分配过程的共单调改进定理，并提出了一种递归方法来构建共单调动态帕累托最优解，前提是代理人的偏好是一致的，并且满足我们称之为“保持等分布”（equidistribution-preserving）的属性。在每个代理人的动态风险度量都属于“扭曲型”（distortion type）的特殊情况下，我们给出了共单调动态帕累托最优解的封闭形式表达式。我们在一个两期设置的例子中展示了我们的研究成果。。研究方法：随机过程。

papers.title: A Discovery Plan for Pharmacy Benefit Managers Collusion
papers.abstract: The Federal Trade Commission has recently filed an administrative complaint against the Big 3 pharmacy benefit managers claiming they engaged in unfair conduct in violation of Section 5 of the FTC Act. They never used the word collusion in the complaint and chose not to sue under The Sherman Act, Section 1. We view this as a novel case of market design collusion rather than a case of price collusion. The Big 3 PBMs are conceptualized as auctioneers soliciting rebate bids off unit list prices in exchange for favored positions on formularies. We will show how the fairness standard of the FTC Act can be made operational by judging fairness against economic theories of good auction design. Discovery is focused on finding explicit communication among the Big 3 PBMs in 2012 to change the so-called winner s determination equation of this auction, adding high gross rebates as a basis for formulary position assignments. On the other hand, we will argue that a case based on a bevy of anecdotes comparing only net unit prices will fail due to complexities in the winners determination equation.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）最近针对三大药品福利管理公司（PBMs）提起了行政投诉，指控其违反了《联邦贸易委员会法》第5条，存在不公平行为。在投诉中，FTC并未使用“勾结”一词，也未选择依据《谢尔曼法》第1条提起诉讼。我们认为这属于一种新型的市场设计勾结行为，而非单纯的价格勾结。这三家PBMs的角色类似于拍卖商，他们通过征集单位药品价格的回扣投标来换取在药品目录中的优先地位。我们将探讨如何运用经济理论中的“良好拍卖设计”标准来评判FTC法所规定的公平性。调查的重点是查明这三家PBMs在2012年是否存在明确沟通，以改变药品目录中获胜者的判定机制（即如何将高额总回扣作为分配药品目录位置的依据）。另一方面，我们认为，仅基于一系列比较药品净单位价格的轶事来构建案件是无法成立的，因为药品目录中获胜者的判定机制本身存在复杂性。。
